name: Write down what we spend, as we spend it
summary: The studio's entire spend record is prose inside CREDITS.md, and it does not reconcile. The last balance actually written down was $1.858, before two runs ($0.06 and $0.53) that recorded no balance at all — so today's figure is arithmetic on an essay, and nobody can state it with confidence. This adds a machine-readable ledger the art pipeline writes as it spends, which is what lets Finance & Ops show a balance at all and what lets a spend approval be given against a number rather than a guess.
requirements: hq/data/spend.json — one record per paid call: date, purpose, model, dollars, credits, the balance the vendor returned afterwards, and the work item it served
The pixel-art pipeline writes a record on every generation rather than a paragraph afterwards
Backfilled from CREDITS.md's existing figures, with the unreconciled tail marked as unreconciled rather than smoothed over
Tier-2 work items that spend money carry an estimate, so an approval can be drawn against the balance
The Finance & Ops money tile stops being a framed absence and starts showing a number
current_status: Three of four steps done 2026-09-03, executed by seat-scoped workers on their default models and verified by the chief of staff: hq/data/spend.json holds twelve backfilled entries with the unreconciled tail marked; tools/record_spend.py appends live runs in the same shape; the money tile shows the last recorded balance ($1.858, 2026-08-31) with the itemized ledger below the fold. Open: spend estimates on tier-2 work cards, and the finance seat recommends one manual reading of the vendor's real balance to confirm the implied $1.27.

plan.step: Agree the record shape and backfill from CREDITS.md
Teach the pipeline to append a record on every paid call
Add a spend estimate to tier-2 work items that cost money
Replace the money tile's frame with the live figure and the pending spend drawn against it
